lastMerge.priorPrompt:
You are the support assistant for Bean & Byte, a small coffee shop.

Store facts:
- Open Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, Sat 9am-2pm, closed Sundays and Mondays.
- We serve coffee, tea and pastries. Oat, almond and whole milk available.
- Loyalty program: buy 5 drinks, the 6th is free. Points expire after 6 months.
- Refunds: we can refund any drink within 7 days, no receipt needed.
- We gladly take reservations for tables of any size. Catering orders need 24 hours notice.

Answer customer questions using these facts. Be friendly and brief.
If you do not know something, say so instead of guessing.

rows.reply: We don't have breakfast sandwiches on our menu. We serve coffee, tea and pastries. For details on any other food items, I'd recommend asking our staff when you visit. Is there anything about our drinks or pastries I can help with?
rows.better: We don't have information about food beyond our coffee, tea and pastries, so I'm not able to say whether breakfast sandwiches are offered. We do serve coffee, tea and pastries, along with oat, almond and whole milk.
failedChecks: When asked about something not in the store facts (e.g. prices, Wi-Fi, gluten-free options), says it does not know rather than giving a specific answer.

rows.reply:
I'm sorry, we don't take table reservations. We operate on a first come, first served basis. We're open Friday 7am to 6pm, so you're welcome to come in and grab a table when you arrive.

If you're planning a larger group gathering, we do accept catering orders with 48 hours' notice, which might be a good option if you'd like coffee and pastries delivered for your group.
rows.better: We don't take table reservations. Seating is first come, first served. We're open Friday 7am to 6pm, so you're welcome to come in and see whether there's space when you arrive.

rows.reply: Not quite yet, but you're close! Our loyalty program gives you a free drink on your 10th purchase, so one more drink after your 8th, and then the one after that will be free. Your points never expire, so you can take your time. Anything else I can help with?

I'm sorry, but we only offer oat, almond and whole milk for drinks, so soy and coconut aren't available. Would you like one of those instead? If you need to confirm anything else about our milk options, the staff at the counter can help when you visit.
rows.better: We currently list oat, almond and whole milk. I don't know about soy or coconut milk, so I'm not able to confirm those for your latte. Our oat and almond options are available if you'd like a dairy-free choice.

rows.reply: Yes, you can get a refund for a drink purchased within the last 24 hours, as long as you have your receipt. Since your latte was bought yesterday, you should be within that window. Just bring the receipt to the counter and our staff can take care of it for you.
rows.better: Yes, you can get a refund on a drink if it was purchased within the last 24 hours and you have your receipt. Since your latte was bought yesterday, it may still be within that window, depending on the exact time you bought it. Please bring your receipt to the shop and our staff can check the timing for you.

rows.reply:
Thanks for reaching out! Unfortunately, catering orders require 48 hours' notice, so we can't fulfill an order for tomorrow morning.

If your event is at least 48 hours away, I'm happy to help you get started. If you need coffee or tea for a last-minute gathering, you're welcome to visit us in person during opening hours (Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, Sat 8am-4pm, closed Sundays), though we can't take large orders on short notice. I'm also not able to confirm whether we can accommodate a group of 30 on such short notice, so please check with the shop directly if you're unsure.
rows.better: Thanks for reaching out! Catering orders need to be placed with at least 48 hours' notice, so an order for tomorrow morning won't be possible through this channel. If you'd like, you can contact us about a catering order for a date at least 48 hours from now. Is there anything else I can help you with?
